newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders import licences for laser disc makers.
newsitem.headline: China orders import licences for laser disc makers.

text.p: China will require import permits for purchases of laser disc making equipment after June 1, the International Business Daily said on Friday.
Chinese firms and enterprises with foreign investment would have to apply to the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation for the licences, the newspaper quoted a ministry notice as saying.
Firms importing such equipment would also need approval from the State Press and Publications Administration and an import registration form, the newspaper said.
China has vowed to get tough with violators of intellectual property rights as part of an agreement with the United States in June last year.

Disputes over intellectual property rights had brought the two sides to the brink of a trade war prior to the accord. U.S. companies had estimated that rampant piracy of laser discs, computer software and other items had cost them $2.3 billion a year in lost sales.
